name: B10-0204/2024 (Renew) – The shrinking space for civil society in Cambodia, in particular the case of the labour rights organisation CENTRAL
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the shrinking space for civil society in Cambodia, in particular the case of the labour rights organisation CENTRAL
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and making requests. It asks Cambodia's government to stop harassing civil society groups, journalists and union activists. It names the labour rights group CENTRAL and its staff member Tharo Khun, and calls for charges against them to be dropped. It also asks the European Union to consider targeted sanctions and to protect people who are persecuted for their political activity.

- No law changes; Parliament only asks Cambodia to drop charges and stop harassment.
- Affects CENTRAL, its staff, journalists, activists and political prisoners in Cambodia.
- Next, the resolution goes to EU bodies and Cambodia's government; EU sanctions are only urged.
